name: @cc/dsh-project-state
description: The project state core: the single writer of state/ — entity schema (REQ/DECISION/TASK/TEST) with YAML frontmatter and a body, typed sequential IDs allocated under a lock, links that store the content hash of their target, compare-and-set TASK transitions, an append-only JSONL journal with replay, snapshot() and verify(). Publishes the ccProjectState host service; no model tools.
